# Kawaki Studios — Full System Context & Architecture Guide

## Overview
Kawaki Studios is a premium web engineering and custom digital design studio. Founded by Kunal Sharma, the studio bridges bespoke design artistry with modern, high-performance web engineering.

- **Website**: https://www.kawaki.co.in
- **Founder**: Kunal Sharma
- **Contact**: hello@kawakistudios.com / partners@kawakistudios.com
- **Locations Served**: Worldwide (US, UK, Europe, UAE, India, Japan)

## Technical Disciplines

### 1. Custom Web Development & Next.js Architecture
- Full-stack custom web applications, Next.js App Router, SSR/SSG hybrid rendering.
- Architecture: Bespoke CMS dashboards, structured Markdown content pipelines, SQLite / LibSQL database synchronization.
- Typography: Curated font pairings (Instrument Serif, Host Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono).
- Accessibility: Level AA compliance (WCAG 2.2), fully keyboard-accessible navigation and modals.

### 2. Shopify Store Development & Headless Commerce
- Frameworks: Shopify Plus, Hydrogen, Remix, Oxygen edge workers, Liquid custom themes.
- Caching: Multi-region Redis session cache, edge route stale-while-revalidate, instant Cart API synchronization.
- Performance: Sub-second catalog browsing, 98+ Lighthouse mobile performance score, high-conversion checkout flows.

### 3. Interactive Web Experiences & WebGL
- Graphics: Three.js, WebGL shaders, GSAP ScrollTrigger physics, Lenis smooth scrolling.
- UI Physics: Magnetic hover states, fluid page transitions, spring-damper interactions.

   - URL: https://www.kawaki.co.in/blog-post?slug=webflow-vs-custom-development

   - Summary: Technical playbook for achieving sub-100ms INP and sub-1s LCP without compromising on editorial design or typography.

5. **The Architecture of Modern Digital Luxury**
   - URL: https://www.kawaki.co.in/blog-post?slug=the-architecture-of-modern-digital-luxury

6. **Headless Commerce at Sub-Second Latency**
